name: Cargo Pants
description: Classic side-pocket hard khaki cargo pants. Built for durability and style, they feature a structured, heavy-duty khaki weave that holds up through active days while maintaining a sharp silhouette.
key_features:
Durable Hard Khaki Fabric: Tough, wear-resistant material designed for long-lasting performance and maximum durability.
Functional Pocket Storage: Deep, button-secured side cargo pockets alongside standard slash pockets to keep your everyday carry secure and accessible.
Versatile Fit: Styled with a structured cut that pairs effortlessly with tees, hoodies, or boots for a rugged streetwear look.
Reinforced Stitching: High-stress points are double-stitched for added resilience through daily wear.
